_readme: Pin a title here when the automatic one comes out wrong.
The key is the boletin label exactly as the CFMI site writes it: "34-2026".
Edit this file on github.com (pencil icon), commit, then run the
'Refresh boletines' workflow from the Actions tab. The website picks up
the change within a few minutes.
Entries for old boletines do no harm - they are simply ignored once the
boletin drops out of the newest four.

titles.32-2026: De la experiencia internacional al desarrollo de una madera estructural segura, competitiva y adaptada a Costa Rica
